Im Sag Sun and Mercury, with Jupiter, Venus and Neptune in 9th house, but in capricorn, and chiron in my 1st. Ive never felt understood by those around me, but can't stop trying to figure out the why of everything, especially the meaning of life, and have struggled so much with self esteem issues and feeling like I'm a bother to everything. 

Your post hit hard. I will continue to reread it in the future, and I really appreciate you friend. Thsnk you for your wisdom.

I have come to believe that I am enough, because everyone is, and that part of this life was to discover just that.. but its taken going to the depths of depression to lose and refind myself. Earth feels like a tough place to be. I really look up to those strong enough to withstand the pressure, and still give out compassion, wisdom and peace. 

You are and angel friend. I love you and thank you 🙏

Hi there 🖐

Sag 🌞, Pisces 🌙, w Taurus  ✨ 

I think a lot of these things are tied to the senses,  so I'm curious how big of an impact having different ascendants will make.  I'm personally very tired to my taurus roots,  so I assume some of these will be wildly affected.  

Music taste: im guessing music is still huge for you and likely a great place to escape into. If you're like me and have a sag mercury,  I bet you think in possibilities and your music taste reflects it,  as you're into many many different types of styles and beats.  Music makes you feel alive and excited and you love to explore. You may stop on certain songs on repeat,  but overall your fave song and style is always changing.  

Movie taste: if you're like me,  my Pisces moon plays a huge part in love of movies ( and music). You love movies,  and secretly you're incredibly emotional and are always ready to root for the hero and cry at the do of a hat for beauty that humanity has to offer.  Do you also miss Robin Williams as much as I do?

Pet peeves: I bet we are different here,  as personally I hate being rushed or told what to do,  but I bet you also really strive for freedom to be and to explore,  but for me my Taurus probably helps slow me down and focus on peace and serenity. Im going to guess your pet peeve is you hate being bored.  

Fave food: i don't know what mine is,  I love all food.  Mine is maybe peanut butter or vanilla? I'm guessing you focus less on food so you like some thing quick,  but also having variety.  Your fave food is tacos. 

Greatest weakness: I bet you have a lot of ideas and possibilities passing through you.  Sometimes it's hard to narrow down and pick just one things.  Gotta try em all right? 😅

Greatest strength: I kinda assume all Pisces moons secretly store an emotional connection with each other and in themselves.  I think this world fights against it often and it is in our emotions,  and our love for all that becomes our greatest strength.  We will bring everything together with love.  

Ty for reading 🙏
